capabilities.title: Canonical scenario registry and schema
capabilities.purpose: One machine-readable source of truth for threat families, scenarios, controls, dependencies, evidence state, and issue linkage.
acceptance: unknown fields fail or are explicitly versioned

capabilities.title: Hermetic adversarial lab and synthetic sink
capabilities.purpose: Ensure realistic browser abuse can be exercised without live targets, real secrets, external traffic, or executable payloads.
acceptance: No fixture can reach the public internet by default

capabilities.title: Trusted-input headed browser rig
capabilities.purpose: Exercise real Chromium/Chrome interaction, extension worlds, popups, permissions, service-worker lifecycle, and extension-origin UI.
acceptance: extension readiness is proved per document

capabilities.title: Pre-harm protection oracle
capabilities.purpose: Distinguish detector activation, warning, post-commit recovery, and actual harm prevention.
acceptance: Every scenario declares a harm boundary
post-commit recovery is never scored as pre-commit prevention

capabilities.title: Invariant-preserving mutation engine
capabilities.purpose: Grade defenses on adjacent variants rather than the fixture they were written against.
acceptance: Each active scenario has invariant-preserving and invariant-breaking mutations
survivors are retained without auto-opening unlimited issues

capabilities.title: Benign and mixed journey corpus
capabilities.purpose: Measure discrimination on realistic multi-step flows where legitimate and malicious behavior coexist.
acceptance: Every attack scenario has a benign control and mixed journey
prompt/block counts are measured per consequential action
controls cover accessibility and uncommon but legitimate flows

capabilities.title: Lifecycle and state-chaos injector
capabilities.purpose: Force worker suspension, bridge loss, BFCache, tab discard, frame replacement, update, and concurrent flow conditions.
acceptance: Security authority is never replayed across document/task boundaries
state traces identify generation and ownership

capabilities.title: Train/tune/holdout corpus governance
capabilities.purpose: Prevent tuning directly against every known fixture and preserve credible unseen evaluation.
acceptance: Related variants cannot cross partitions accidentally
holdout remains unread by implementation agents until evaluation
corpus provenance and hashes are recorded

capabilities.title: Evidence ledger, failure capture, and scorecard
capabilities.purpose: Make every security claim traceable to exact code, browser, fixture, mutation set, comparator, and limitation.
acceptance: No scenario can be marked complete without required evidence
results link exact commit and browser version

capabilities.title: Differential browser and comparator runner
capabilities.purpose: Measure additive value and regressions against browser-native protection and relevant extensions.
acceptance: Runs use supported branded browsers where required
wins, misses, latency, interruptions, and data handling are reported

capabilities.title: Typed evidence and signal registry
capabilities.purpose: Give scoring, explanations, experiments, and stored outcomes one versioned representation of evidence, provenance, direction, confidence, and decay.
acceptance: Existing behavior is byte/decision parity in the first slice

capabilities.title: Consequence model and scoped intent capabilities
capabilities.purpose: Represent what action is authorized, by whom, for which tab/document/destination/data category, for how long, and how many times.
acceptance: One gesture cannot authorize a second consequence

capabilities.title: Extension-origin decision authority
capabilities.purpose: Ensure page-controlled UI can never proceed, trust, allow, resume, or otherwise lower protection.
acceptance: All protection-lowering actions occur in extension origin

capabilities.title: Bridge identity, liveness, recovery, and fail policy
capabilities.purpose: Prevent hostile page takeover or silent loss of the MAIN↔isolated channel and expose per-capability readiness.
acceptance: high-risk sinks follow declared fail-safe behavior

capabilities.title: Episode and attack-narrative engine
capabilities.purpose: Correlate cross-event stories across clicks, redirects, popups, clipboard, credentials, permissions, transactions, and lifecycle.
acceptance: Slow/split-step variants weaken rather than bypass through TTL cliffs
legacy decisions remain unchanged in shadow mode

capabilities.title: Local Data Flow Lens
capabilities.purpose: Show what categories of data a page accessed or transmitted, to which origin/channel, under what action, and whether the observation is inferred or proven.
acceptance: Default mode stores no raw values
optional powerful permissions are isolated and explicit
user can inspect and clear retained metadata

capabilities.title: Relationship and trust ledger
capabilities.purpose: Use user-owned relationship history as a strong benign prior and expose destination identity before action without granting immunity.
acceptance: Familiarity reduces noise but cannot suppress high-consequence anomaly
no password values or raw history dossier by default

capabilities.title: Confidence, abstention, and attention budget
capabilities.purpose: Route uncertain and low-value findings to a journal rather than either nagging or silently discarding them.
acceptance: High-severity invariant events cannot be hidden by budget
shadow replay demonstrates recall/noise tradeoff before behavior change

capabilities.title: Capability readiness and failure-mode matrix
capabilities.purpose: State exactly which protections are active for the current tab/document and what happens when permissions, bridge, worker, browser surface, or companion are unavailable.
acceptance: UI never implies protection from stale events
every high-risk sink has declared unavailable behavior
readiness is testable in fresh profiles and after reload

capabilities.title: Reversible deceptive-surface remediation
capabilities.purpose: Suppress high-confidence foreground traps without replaying clicks, while preserving legitimate dialogs and a durable Undo path.

capabilities.title: Credential and protected-data sink guard
capabilities.purpose: Protect passwords and other declared secrets at submit, script-read, or network-sink boundaries while remaining quiet on legitimate forms.
acceptance: same-origin script exfil is represented as a separate evidence class

capabilities.title: Authorization, consent, and transaction integrity
capabilities.purpose: Bind OAuth/SSO/permission/payment review to the exact client, redirect, scope, recipient, amount, window, and task.
acceptance: Generic parameters do not create broad false positives

capabilities.title: Permission consequence mediator
capabilities.purpose: Explain and govern site/browser permission grants by task relevance, persistence, actor, and chained escalation.
acceptance: no page text is treated as consent

capabilities.title: Download and artifact provenance
capabilities.purpose: Preserve initiator, redirect, filename/MIME, relationship, and optional signature/hash evidence from click to download and native handoff.
acceptance: No artifact is executed in automated tests
mismatches are evidence rather than malware verdicts

capabilities.title: Agent conduct policy and flight recorder
capabilities.purpose: Attribute delegated actions and require exact policy for credentials, permissions, downloads, payments, and cross-origin consequences.
acceptance: Agent-suspected alone never hard-blocks accessibility users
high-consequence delegated actions need explicit scope
task state cannot cross tabs or agents

capabilities.title: Native-messaging protocol and minimal host
capabilities.purpose: Provide a versioned, least-privilege, local-only transport for capabilities MV3 cannot supply.
acceptance: minimal echo PoC passes on supported OS

capabilities.title: Clipboard taint and shell-sink sentinel
capabilities.purpose: Correlate a suspicious browser clipboard write with a paste into a narrowly defined shell-class target.
acceptance: real OS false-interdiction rate is measured

capabilities.title: Artifact scan and execution-boundary adapter
capabilities.purpose: Optionally inspect inert/downloaded artifact metadata and enforce a user-approved handoff before execution-class actions.
acceptance: scanner errors cannot silently mark safe

capabilities.title: Header, DNS, proxy, and network-context observer
capabilities.purpose: Add context structurally unavailable or incomplete in MV3 without intercepting TLS or exporting browsing data.

capabilities.title: Local model host with untrusted-sensor contract
capabilities.purpose: Host optional larger local classifiers while keeping model output capped, schema-validated, and non-authoritative.

capabilities.title: Signed installer, updater, rollback protection, and external review
capabilities.purpose: Prevent the privileged companion distribution path from becoming the project's largest security liability.
acceptance: keys and recovery process are documented
exact release artifact receives independent review
